Claim: Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold said dead people and noncitizens should vote.
Who_Pushed_It: A television statement (about September 2026); the broadcast was not identified
Reason: No record of Griswold saying this was found. Her documented statements describe removing deceased voters using state health and Social Security death data, and rejecting noncitizen registrations. Her office's 2022 postcards to about 30,000 noncitizens (a mailing error, not ballots or forms) are described on the Voters & Population page.

Claim: "EXPOSED: Democrats' Big Oil Payoff Scheme... FBI Subpoenas Incoming" (gas prices are "not the Iran war")
Who_Pushed_It: X post by @TrumpNews, byline "Jonathan Gregory", Sep 23, 2026
Reason: No DOJ or FBI press release, court filing or other record of such subpoenas was found. The same byline appeared on an earlier unsupported "seven FBI agents vs. Pelosi" story. The post's price figures roughly match EIA, but its claim that high prices are "not the Iran war" contradicts EIA and IEA data showing a war-driven shortage of refined products. FEC records show oil-industry PAC money going mostly to Republicans. Details: Gas Price Gap Tracker (gas-gap.html#gg-6).
